# Broadway Scorecard

> Broadway Scorecard is a data-driven review aggregation site for Broadway shows. It combines critic reviews from 420+ outlets, audience scores, and community buzz into composite ratings for 727+ Broadway productions spanning 1970 to the present.

Broadway Scorecard aggregates and scores theater reviews using a tier-weighted system: Tier 1 outlets (NYT, Vulture, Variety) count most, Tier 2 (TheaterMania, NY Post) less, and Tier 3 (blogs) least. Each show receives a composite score from 0-100 based on 14,000+ individually scored reviews.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://broadwayscorecard.com/): Currently running Broadway shows with scores and rankings
- [Best Broadway Shows Guide](https://broadwayscorecard.com/guides/best-broadway-shows): Curated guide to the highest-rated shows currently on Broadway
- [Best Broadway Musicals](https://broadwayscorecard.com/guides/best-broadway-musicals): Top-rated musicals currently running
- [Best Broadway Plays](https://broadwayscorecard.com/guides/best-broadway-plays): Top-rated plays currently running
- [Rankings](https://broadwayscorecard.com/rankings): All-time Broadway show rankings by composite critic score
- [Tony Awards Hub](https://broadwayscorecard.com/tony-awards): Data-driven Tony Awards predictions, all-time leaderboard, and 12 seasons of historical accuracy data
- [Tony Award Nominees](https://broadwayscorecard.com/tony-awards/nominees): Every nominee ranked by critic score, audience grade, and win odds from GoldDerby — all 26 categories
- [Beat the Critics](https://broadwayscorecard.com/beat-the-critics): Make your Tony Award picks and compare predictions against top critics and the CriticScore algorithm
- [Broadway Award Scorecard](https://broadwayscorecard.com/award-score): Prestige-weighted award scores across Tony, Pulitzer, Drama Desk, Outer Critics Circle, and more
- [Trending Shows](https://broadwayscorecard.com/trending): Top 10 buzziest Broadway shows by audience activity and social signals
- [Off-Broadway Shows](https://broadwayscorecard.com/off-broadway): CriticScore ratings for Off-Broadway shows in NYC, aggregated from NYT, Vulture, Variety, Time Out, and more
- [West End Shows](https://broadwayscorecard.com/west-end): CriticScore ratings for London West End shows — musicals and plays ranked by UK theatre critic consensus
- [Broadway Lotteries](https://broadwayscorecard.com/lotteries): Digital lottery info for discount Broadway tickets
- [Broadway Rush Tickets](https://broadwayscorecard.com/rush): Rush ticket availability and policies
- [Best Value Broadway Tickets](https://broadwayscorecard.com/best-value): Highest-rated shows with discount ticket options
- [Box Office Data](https://broadwayscorecard.com/box-office): Weekly Broadway grosses and financial performance
- [Broadway Business](https://broadwayscorecard.com/biz): Recoupment status and commercial performance of Broadway shows
- [Audience Buzz](https://broadwayscorecard.com/audience-buzz): Audience ratings from Show Score, Mezzanine, and Reddit sentiment
- [Critics Index](https://broadwayscorecard.com/critics): Directory of 870+ theater critics and their scoring tendencies
- [Outlets Index](https://broadwayscorecard.com/critics/outlets): Directory of 420+ review outlets covering Broadway
- [Methodology](https://broadwayscorecard.com/methodology): How scores are calculated, tier weighting, and data sources

## Show Pages

Each show page (e.g., /show/hamilton, /show/wicked) includes: composite critic score, individual review scores and excerpts, audience ratings, lottery/rush availability, cast and creative team, box office data, and theater information.

- [Broadway Musicals](https://broadwayscorecard.com/browse/broadway-musicals): All scored musicals
- [Broadway Plays](https://broadwayscorecard.com/browse/broadway-plays): All scored plays

- [Shows for Kids](https://broadwayscorecard.com/guides/best-broadway-shows-for-kids): Family-friendly recommendations
- [Cheap Broadway Tickets Guide](https://broadwayscorecard.com/guides/cheap-broadway-tickets): How to get discount tickets

- [Gold Lists](https://broadwayscorecard.com/lists): Curated best-of lists by season and all-time

- [Submit a Review](https://broadwayscorecard.com/submit-review): Submit a missing critic review
